scenes.tts: Before the genetic alphabet was understood, Fischer had already charted the purines: he gave the class its name, synthesized purine itself in 1898, and prepared on the order of 130 derivatives — caffeine, the uric acid of gout, and the bases later read as letters of the code.
scenes.visual: timeline: before the genetic alphabet; purines named; 1898; ~130 derivatives incl. caffeine, uric acid, code bases
scenes.narration: Before the genetic alphabet was understood, Fischer had already charted the purines: he gave the class its name, synthesized purine itself in 1898, and prepared on the order of 130 derivatives — caffeine, the uric acid of gout, and the bases later read as letters of the code.

scenes.tts: That work, alongside his sugars, won him the 1902 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, the second ever awarded.
scenes.visual: purines + sugars -> 1902 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, second ever awarded
scenes.narration: That work, alongside his sugars, won him the 1902 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, the second ever awarded.

scenes.tts: His lock-and-key principle — that a molecule's shape, not just its formula, decides what it can do — is the idea every drug in this chapter exploits.
scenes.visual: lock and key schematic; shape not formula; every drug
scenes.narration: His lock-and-key principle — that a molecule's shape, not just its formula, decides what it can do — is the idea every drug in this chapter exploits.
